title: Learn How to Pullup
author: mery
desc:
This program was built to turn someone who cant do a single pullup, into someone who can.

If you finished the 6 weeks and still cant perform a pullup, repeat the 6th week whilst adding reps until you can do bodyweight.

Once you can perform bodyweight pullups, incorporate them into your program to not lose the skill.

ex.note: Start from dead hang, perform scapular chin-up motion, then pull as hard as you can, even if you move one inch, it was successful.
